message.content: The webhook handler dies on duplicate deliveries from FakePay.

content.text: Root cause: FakePay redelivers on any 5xx, and the handler has no idempotency-key check, so the second delivery hits a unique-constraint violation. Adding the check.

input.new_string:
if (await alreadyProcessed(event.idempotencyKey)) return ok();
await recordPayment(event);

input.command: npm test && git commit -am 'fix: idempotency check for duplicate webhook deliveries'
